titles.native: 河原崎家の一族 THE ANIMATION

description:
Based on the erotic game by Silky's.

The days at a hostal doesn't seem to be very normal. Instead the visitors get a special treatement. The maids are always on dispose to serve their masters even if it is something not really normal. Hiden room and double view mirrors are only a part of this ex-state building.

(Source: Anme News Network)
